channel.title: Women's Wear Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Women's Wear Daily (wwd.com)

item.title: Summer Fridays’ Marianna Hewitt and Lauren Ireland Chat About the Power of Social Media and Building Brand Longevity
item.description: The beauty brand founders chatted with WWD on the Beauty of Tomorrow podcast to discuss how social media and the creator economy helped make it a fan favorite.

item.title: Key Takeaways From Beauty’s Earnings Season
item.description: Fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 results point to slowdowns in skin care and fragrance, continued weakness in travel retail but a pickup in M&A.

item.title: Vivetta Ponti After Vivetta: First Look at the Designer’s New Brand
item.description: Named Venerdì Pomeriggio, the label debuting on the opening day of Milan Fashion Week is an invitation to slow down.

item.title: Wellness Is Integrating Its Ethos Into Branded Residences; Here’s How
item.description: Italian design firm Visionnaire and The Longevity Suite, Europe’s most advanced biohacking and antiaging clinic, are the latest to foray into the buoyant branded residences market.

item.title: Bebe Teams With Dolls Kill for Limited-edition Collection Blending Y2K Nostalgia and Modern Style
item.description: Updated logo tanks, body-hugging silhouettes, low-rise denim, and the return of the famed two-piece tracksuit are featured in the line.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Olaplex Updates Hero With No.3Plus Launch
item.description: The new formula, replacing the original No.3, focuses on immediate payoff as well as ease of use.

item.title: Maria Grazia Chiuri’s New Chapter at Fendi
item.description: Ahead of her first runway show for the Italian luxury brand on Wednesday, the chief creative officer looks to the future while fully respecting the past and the legendary five Fendi sisters.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Melissa Reunites With Hello Kitty and Friends on Playful Collection
EXCLUSIVE: Zadig & Voltaire Appoints Dan Sablon Creative Director
item.description: Vogue France culture director Dan Sablon will make his runway debut March 9 at Palais Galliera as the brand accelerates into lifestyle and accessories.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Loewe Names Théodore Pellerin Its Newest Brand Ambassador
item.description: The Canadian actor is currently shooting Tom Ford’s "Cry to Heaven" in Rome.
